title: Governor’s Statement on Statewide COVID-19 Mitigation Measures and Emergency Public Health Response
summary: The governor announces new statewide COVID-19 measures—including mask mandates, temporary lockdowns, and redeployment of state resources—to curb rising infections and protect the healthcare system.
body:
Today, as Governor of the State of Minnesota, I am addressing our residents during a time of rising COVID-19 cases and growing pressure on our healthcare system. The latest data from the Minnesota Department of Health shows a concerning increase in infections and hospitalizations, and we must act quickly and responsibly to protect one another—especially our most vulnerable neighbors.
Effective immediately, Minnesota will require masks in all indoor public spaces, regardless of vaccination status. This includes schools, workplaces, stores, public transit, and state buildings. This step is about keeping one another safe, slowing the spread of the virus, and helping ensure that our hospitals can continue to care for those who need them most.
We are also introducing temporary stay-at-home measures in areas experiencing the highest transmission rates. These are intended to reduce non-essential contact and prevent further spread, while still ensuring that essential services remain open and accessible to the public.
At the same time, we are mobilizing state resources to support a stronger and faster public health response. This includes expanding testing availability, speeding up vaccine and booster distribution, reinforcing hospital staffing, and delivering critical supplies where they are needed most. Every part of our state government is being directed to support this effort.
These actions are being taken under Executive Order 0001, and I recognize that they affect daily life in meaningful ways. But they are grounded in care for our communities and in the responsibility we share to protect each other. Minnesota has faced difficult moments before, and we have always met them with resilience, compassion, and a commitment to doing what is right for the greater good.
